title: Volatile native editors for agent forms

claims.text: openForm maps each form kind through labels to a tool and caches volatile drafts in Drafts under an agent plus kind plus runId cache key.
submit assembles payloads with getBody and validate against unitSchema, including the canonical 6000-byte budget check on memory units.
bindEpisode freezes episode run_id, task_id, seat and parents_context read from the opened run via run_get before submission.

decision.rule: Change here when volatile form fields, schema-driven serialization, episode binding or derive selection needs to change.
decision.failure: Drafts are lost on reload, submissions fail validation, or an episode is bound to a closed or mismatched run.

questions.q: Where does openForm build memory, run, close, resume and derive form fields?
Where should I change how submit validates the canonical byte budget and unit schema?
Where can I debug why episode fields are frozen by the opened run?
